name: DAAD Scholarships in Germany for Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
field_of_study: Economic Sciences; Business Administration; Political Economics; Development Cooperation; Engineering; Mathematics; Agriculture; Environmental Sciences; Public Health
value: 992 euros, 1,300 euros, monthly stipend, travel allowance, health insurance
eligibility: International students; verify country eligibility on the official site.
description: DAAD Masters/PhD Degree Deadline: Aug-Oct 2026 (annual) Study in: Germany Next course starts AY 2027/2028 The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) scholarships offer foreign graduates from development and newly industrialized countries from all disciplines and with at least two years' professional experience the chance to take a postgraduate or Master's degree at a state or state-recognized German university. Masters or PhD courses in Economic Sciences/Business Administration/Political Economics; Development Cooperation; Engineering and Related Sciences; Mathematics; Regional and Urban Planning; Agricultural and Forest Sciences; Environmental Sciences; Public Health.

name: Rhodes Scholarships at Oxford University for International Students
field_of_study: Any full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Oxford
value: £20,400, monthly stipend, travel allowance, health insurance
eligibility: Applicant must fulfil the citizenship and residency requirements of the Rhodes constituency for which they are applying.
description: The Rhodes Scholarships are postgraduate awards supporting exceptional all-round students at the University of Oxford. Established in the will of Cecil Rhodes in 1902, the Rhodes is the oldest and perhaps the most prestigious international scholarship program in the world. Subject to limited restrictions, Rhodes Scholars may study any full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Oxford. A class of 95 Scholars is selected each year.

name: University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS)
field_of_study: Research-based Masters and PhD across all disciplines
eligibility: Be a commencing or enrolled international student; have an unconditional offer of admission or be currently enrolled in a master's by research or PhD at the University of Sydney.
description: The University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS) provides a yearly scholarship to high quality international postgraduate students who wish to study a master's by research or PhD. The scholarship assists with tuition fees and living costs.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program in USA
field_of_study: Most academic fields
value: monthly stipend, tuition, travel allowance, health insurance
eligibility: International students; verify country eligibility on the official site.
description: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program enables graduate students, young professionals and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States at U.S. universities or other academic institutions. Fulbright encourages applications from all fields. Approximately 4,000 foreign students receive Fulbright scholarships each year.

name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt Masters Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance
field_of_study: Economics; Health; Law; Education; Political Science; Development; Management; Arts; Science
value: €., monthly stipend, tuition, travel allowance, health insurance
eligibility: Graduates from developing countries committed to obtaining a Master's degree in disciplines relevant to social; political and economic development of their home country.
description: The DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme Masters Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance offers very good graduates from developing countries the chance to obtain a Master's degree in disciplines relevant to the social, political and economic development of their home country at German institutions.

name: Adelaide Global Academic Excellence Scholarships for International Students
field_of_study: Most undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs
eligibility: Be an international student; be applying to study a CRICOS registered bachelor degree (minimum 96 units) or a CRICOS registered master degree (minimum 72 units) at Adelaide University.
description: The University of Adelaide Global Academic Excellence Scholarship (International) rewards commencing undergraduate and postgraduate coursework international students who have demonstrated academic excellence. The scholarship is a 50% reduction of the tuition fees.

name: University of New South Wales International Scholarships
field_of_study: Most undergraduate and postgraduate programs
eligibility: Must be an international student; be commencing full-time study in a UNSW undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree program in Term 3, 2026.
description: UNSW offers a wide range of Scholarships and Awards to support International undergraduate and postgraduate coursework students commencing full-time study at UNSW including the International Scientia Coursework Scholarships and Australia's Global University Award.

name: The Glenmore Medical Postgraduate Scholarship at the University of Edinburgh
field_of_study: Medicine; Medical Sciences; Public Health; Health; Data Science; Biology
eligibility: International students from eligible developing countries admitted to eligible Human Medical programmes offered by the University in the 2026-2027 academic session.
description: Four scholarships available for postgraduate full-time one year Masters study for eligible Human Medical programmes at the University of Edinburgh. The scholarship will cover full tuition fees for the duration of the programme.

name: Bocconi Graduate Award
field_of_study: Economics; Finance; Management; Business; Data Science; Law
eligibility: International students; verify country eligibility on the official site.
description: Bocconi Merit Awards are offered for first graduate applicants for the 2026-2027 academic year based on their academic standing. The Merit Award includes a full tuition and fees waiver. Academic profiles considered to be amongst the top applicants will be considered for a Merit Award based on the admission application.

name: Australia Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarships
field_of_study: Research Masters and PhD across all disciplines at Australian universities
eligibility: An RTP Fees Offset pays for the tuition fees of a higher degree by research (HDR) student. An RTP Stipend assists students with their living costs while undertaking a higher degree by research.
description: The RTP provides block grants to higher education providers to support both domestic and overseas students undertaking Research Doctorate and Research Masters degrees. Masters by research degree or Doctorate Degree offered by participating Universities in Australia.

name: IOE Centenary Masters Scholarships
field_of_study: Education; Teaching; Pedagogy; Social Sciences; Arts; Science
eligibility: Domiciled in an eligible low or lower-middle income country according to the World Bank classification; have an official unconditional offer to study a full time master's degree at IOE.
description: IOE is offering Centenary Masters Scholarships for students who plan to work either in their home country or another to improve the circumstances of disadvantaged, excluded or underachieving citizens. Full-time Taught Master's Degree programmes at UCL Institute of Education. Scholarships cover full tuition fees and accommodation at International Students House.

name: Italian Government Scholarships for Foreign Students
field_of_study: Arts; Music; Dance; Sciences; Engineering; Humanities; Design
eligibility: Applicants must provide a certificate of their proficiency in Italian language.
description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI) offers grants in favor of foreign citizens for the academic year 2026-2027 to foster international cultural, scientific and technological cooperation and to promote Italian language and culture. Grants are for study, training, and research programs at Italian Higher Education Institutes.

name: Padua International Excellence Scholarship Programme
field_of_study: Most bachelor's and master's degree programmes taught in English
eligibility: Do not possess Italian citizenship; hold a non-Italian foreign secondary school certificate (for Bachelor's) or a non-Italian Bachelor's degree (for Master's); apply for English-taught degree programmes at the University of Padua.
description: The University of Padua offers scholarships to highly talented prospective students wishing to pursue a Bachelor's or Master's degree completely held in English in Padua. The scholarship includes a subsistence allowance of €8,000 and a tuition fee waiver per academic year.

name: Glasgow International Leadership Scholarships
field_of_study: Most postgraduate taught master's programmes
eligibility: Hold an offer of a place for a postgraduate taught programme for September 2026; have International or EU (non-UK) fee status.
description: The University of Glasgow has several Global Leadership Scholarships available to International fee students starting a postgraduate taught Masters programme in any discipline for Academic Session 2026/2027. The scholarship is awarded as a tuition fees discount.

name: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarships
field_of_study: Undergraduate programs across all faculties
eligibility: Citizen of a country with a Gross Domestic Product per capita of US$10,000 or less based on World Bank data; have applied for and meet the entry requirements for an Overseas Fee place in a bachelor degree.
description: The International Undergraduate Scholarship is awarded to high achieving international students in recognition of their excellent academic results. The scholarship provides a 25 per cent fee sponsorship for the duration of the course.

name: Rotary Foundation Global Scholarship Grants for Development
field_of_study: Health; Education; Development; Peacebuilding; Water and Sanitation; Community Development
eligibility: International students; verify country eligibility on the official site.
description: The Rotary Foundation offers scholarship funding through the Rotary Foundation Global Grants. The scholarships fund graduate-level coursework or research in one of Rotary's six areas of focus: Peace and conflict prevention, Disease prevention and treatment, Water and sanitation, Maternal and child health, Basic education and literacy, and Economic and community development.

name: UAL/ISH International Postgraduate Scholarships
field_of_study: Art; Design; Fashion; Media; Communication; Creative Arts
eligibility: You are not eligible to apply if you already hold a UK postgraduate taught qualification from studies undertaken in the UK or abroad.
description: The UAL/ISH International Postgraduate Scholarship provides £10,000 tuition waiver scholarships to students from developing countries pursuing a full-time or part-time taught Masters course at one of UAL's six Colleges. Up to 288 scholarships are available for the 26/27 academic year.

name: University of the People Online Tuition Free Degrees
field_of_study: Computer Science; Business Administration; Health Science; Education
eligibility: Open to all students worldwide with a high-school qualification and English proficiency, with priority for those who have been in foster care.
description: The University of the People is the world's first tuition-free, non-profit, American accredited, online university. It offers four-year bachelor's degree programs in business administration, computer science, and health science, making higher education accessible to students anywhere including across Africa.

name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships for International Students
field_of_study: Agriculture; Education; Development; Management; Renewable Energy; Public Sector
eligibility: Eligible international students to study fulltime at a New Zealand education institution or a Pacific university.
description: The New Zealand Government offers full tertiary scholarships for eligible international students to study fulltime at a New Zealand education institution. Undergraduate and Postgraduate Degrees in preferred fields most relevant to the development needs of your country such as renewable energy, agriculture development, disaster risk management, and public sector development.

name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
field_of_study: Education; Development; Arts; Most postgraduate fields
eligibility: Hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent training; be admitted to a reputable postgraduate institution; have no other means of financing studies.
description: The Aga Khan Foundation provides a limited number of scholarships each year for postgraduate studies to outstanding students from developing countries who have no other means of financing their studies. Scholarships are awarded on a 50% grant : 50% loan basis. The Foundation gives priority to Master's level courses.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
field_of_study: Health; Education; Governance; Infrastructure; Agriculture; Development; Sustainability
eligibility: Be a citizen of a participating country; not be a citizen of Australia or hold permanent residency; not be applying for a visa to live in Australia permanently.
description: Australia Awards Scholarships provide opportunities for people from developing countries to undertake full time undergraduate or postgraduate study at participating Australian universities. Programmes are related to your country's priority areas for development.

name: Government of Flanders Master Mind Scholarships for International Students
field_of_study: Education; Arts; Science; Engineering; Technology
eligibility: Eligible Masters Degree Programmes offered at participating Flemish Institutions; excludes preparatory programmes and distance learning.
description: The Flemish Ministry of Education awards scholarships for master's programmes in Flanders and Brussels to outstanding students from around the world. The programme aims to promote Flanders and Brussels as a top study destination at KU Leuven, University of Antwerp, Ghent University, and other Flemish institutions.

name: Science@Leuven Scholarships for International Students
field_of_study: Data Science; Mathematics; Physics; Chemistry; Biology; Computer Science; Science; Health; Development
value: 12,000 Euro, tuition, health insurance, living allowance
eligibility: Master of Astronomy and Astrophysics; Master of Biophysics, Biochemistry and Biotechnology; Master of Biology; Master of Chemistry; Master of Geography; Master of Geology; Master of Mathematics; Master of Physics; Master of Statistics and Data Science.
description: The Science@Leuven Scholarships are for motivated and talented international students interested in an international master programme of the Faculty of Science at KU Leuven. The amount of the scholarship can be up to 12,000 Euro for 1 year, always covering tuition fee, insurance and basic health insurance.

name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarships
field_of_study: Science; Engineering; Mathematics; Computer Science; Economics; Data Science
eligibility: Newly arrived international students, aged 30 and less during the course of the selection year; students of foreign nationality living in France for less than a year.
description: The Université Paris-Saclay, through the IDEX scholarships, promotes access to its master's programs to international students. The scholarship supports highly-qualified foreign students wishing to develop an academic project through research up to the doctoral level at one of France's leading research universities.

name: Joint Japan World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
field_of_study: Economics; Public Policy; Health; Education; Infrastructure; Development; Environment
value: monthly stipend, tuition, travel allowance, health insurance
eligibility: Be a national of a World Bank member developing country; hold a bachelor's degree earned at least 3 years prior to the deadline; be employed in development-related work in a paid full-time position at time of application; have at least 3 years of paid development-related experience.
description: The Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) is open to women and men from developing countries with relevant professional experience and a history of supporting their countries' development efforts who are applying to a master degree program in a development-related topic. Scholarships cover tuition, a monthly living stipend, round-trip airfare, and health insurance.

name: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarships in Belgium
field_of_study: Engineering; Computer Science; Data Science; Environmental Science; Education; Development; Management; Agriculture; Science
eligibility: Students from 30 eligible countries in Africa, Asia and Latin-America to attend one of the study programmes taught in English at Flemish universities. Africa: Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Guinea, Kenya, Madagascar, Mali, Morocco, Mozambique, Niger, Rwanda, Senegal, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, Zimbabwe.
description: VLIR-UOS awards ICP Connect Master's scholarships to students from eligible developing countries to attend study programmes taught in English at Flemish universities. The scholarships cover tuition fees, health insurance, and a living allowance.

name: University of Geneva Excellence Masters Fellowships
field_of_study: Science; Chemistry; Physics; Biology; Mathematics; Computer Science; Environmental Science
eligibility: International students; verify country eligibility on the official site.
description: The Faculty of Science of the University of Geneva has established an Excellence Fellowship Program to support outstanding and highly motivated candidates who intend to pursue a Master of Science in any of the disciplines covered by the Faculty. The scholarship is awarded for one year and extended for the regular duration of the Master's programme provided the applicant is academically successful.

name: York University International Student Scholarships
field_of_study: Engineering; Business; Health; Environmental Science; Education; Arts; Design; Media; Science
eligibility: International students; verify country eligibility on the official site.
description: York University offers scholarships for international students pursuing a full-time undergraduate degree. Any undergraduate degree program beginning in the Fall 2025 term under the faculties of Arts, Media, Performance & Design; Environmental Studies; Education; Health; Lassonde School of Engineering; Science; or the Schulich School of Business. Scholarships are renewable for three years provided high academic standing is maintained.

name: Macquarie Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships
field_of_study: Health; Arts; Science; Engineering; Business; Education
eligibility: Achieve a minimum WAM equivalent of 65 for Postgraduate applications; or a minimum ATAR equivalent of 85 for Undergraduate applications.
description: The Macquarie University Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship is awarded to recognise academic excellence for international students. It provides a partial tuition fee scholarship for outstanding students to study an undergraduate or postgraduate degree at Macquarie University. The scholarship amount is up to AUD$10,000 and is applied towards tuition fees.
